0022600185.text: The Kings (1-6, 15th in the West and 5th in the Pacific, 4.5 games back) host the Lakers (6-2, 1st in the Pacific), with Sacramento coming off a win after losing six of their previous seven and sitting 0-2 at home. Sacramento is without Ben Simmons (Achilles, surgery), Dylan Cardwell (calf strain), Keegan Murray (ankle), and Maxime Raynaud (knee, dislocated), while Los Angeles is missing Adou Thiero (knee inflammation). The teams have not met yet this season, and in 2025-26 the Kings lost the series 1-3, including a 128-104 loss in Los Angeles on March 1, 2026.
